ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels with a ratio of approximately 85:15 relative to low-intensity (black/grey) pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous high-intensity white field across the central and proximal regions. Low-intensity, circular/ovoid clusters (mottling) are distributed throughout, with a higher spatial density observed along the trailing edges and concentrated at the lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center-point with an estimated vertex angle between 50-65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged topography and clusters of high-contrast bumps (protrusions) are present at both the left and right distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex outward sweep toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of circular, low-intensity pixel clusters (rosettes) across the ventral surface, particularly concentrated in the distal third of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of epibiotic growth (likely barnacles) creating high-contrast, irregular textural masses at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
